subject: Re: MAP draft + pricing approval for StellarSys pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kate O'Connell <kate@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T14:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft and next steps

Hi Kate,

Thanks for the time today — great discovery call. Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, target close date, responsibilities, and dependencies. High level recap below and suggested next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of needs we heard:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + routing (pilot)
- Security: SAML SSO, VPC peering, SOC2/controls review
- Performance: 99th pct latency SLO for API calls during pilot windows

Draft MAP milestones (attached):
1) Pilot kickoff (engineering and data access): target Mar 8 2026 — responsibility: StellarSys engineering / Redwood integration SME
2) Engineering eval & perf tuning: Mar 8–Mar 22 2026 — responsibility: both teams
3) Procurement & legal sign (SOW + SLA): target Mar 25 2026 — responsibility: StellarSys procurement + Redwood legal
4) Production launch (limited rollout): target Apr 15 2026 — responsibility: StellarSys product + Redwood customer success

Dependencies:
- SAML config and test account from StellarSys (needed for pilot kickoff)
- Network allowlist / VPC peering (security team)
- Procurement timeline and commitment level decision (12-month reserved commit recommended for the pricing shown)

Pricing / approval request:
- StellarSys asked about a discount and onboarding credits during the call. To move forward with the MAP and target dates, we need exec pricing approval for the requested concession: 20% discount off list for a 12-month commitment and $50k onboarding credits.

Next steps I propose:
- Please review the attached MAP and confirm responsibilities and dates by EOD Fri 2/27
- If you need an exec-level justification packet for procurement/CFO, I can pull a cost-breakdown and ROI sketch for the CFO call
- Rishi and I will loop in legal to prepare SOW + redlines once pricing is agreed

Attachments: StellarSys_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP draft), pricing_breakdown_2026-02-27.xlsx (initial pricing worksheet)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Kate O'Connell <kate@stellarsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@stellarsys.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft and next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the MAP — this is helpful. We like the proposed milestones and the responsibilities are clear. A couple of items from our side before we can commit to the March dates:

1) Exec/QoE review: Our VP of Product and CFO would like a short cost/benefit summary. Can you provide a one-pager showing projected token costs and expected latency/availability for the pilot?
2) Pricing: Procurement is asking for justification on discounts and credits — they want to see why 20% + $50k credits is needed.
3) Timeline: Our procurement needs two business days after the CFO call to circulate the SOW to legal.

Can you arrange a 30-minute call with your finance or sales ops person next week? Samir and I are available Tue 3/3 after 1pm PT or Wed 3/4 in the morning.

Also copying procurement@stellarsys.com so they have visibility.

Thanks,
Kate
Head of Product, StellarSys
Kate O'Connell

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing recommendation for StellarSys (RDW-2026-SS-089)

Team,

Following Marissa's note and the external ask for a discount justification, I've run the numbers on the projected pilot and 12-month commit scenario. Quick recommendation for approval: offer a compromise concession of 15% discount + $25k onboarding credits for a 12-month reserved commit. Rationale:
- 15% preserves unit economics vs list and incentivizes 12-month commitment
- $25k credits offsets onboarding integration work and reduces procurement friction
- Forecasted ARR uplift and net retention on this segment justifies this level at our current cost structure

Attached: pricing_breakdown_2026-02-27.xlsx with model assumptions.

Asking for a manager/exec approval (Vivek or Sales Ops lead) to confirm we can present 15% + $25k as final to the customer. If legal sees any SOW implications, please flag.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kate O'Connell <kate@stellarsys.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Updated MAP + proposed pricing (15% + $25k credits)

Hi all,

Per Rishi's recommendation and the external feedback, attached is an updated MAP (StellarSys_MAP_v2.xlsx) with adjusted dates and responsibilities. Key changes:
- Pilot kickoff pushed to Mar 10 to allow StellarSys to complete SAML configuration
- Procurement sign target moved to Mar 29 to account for CFO call and legal review
- Added explicit responsible owners for network & security tasks (StellarSys infra + Redwood security SME)

Pricing concession proposed to present to StellarSys: 15% discount + $25k onboarding credits for a 12-month reserved commit. We believe this meets procurement halfway and keeps our unit economics acceptable.

Kate — if this looks good to you, we request exec approval to present the concession during the CFO/Procurement call. Dev — can you confirm the SOW timeline and whether the redline in the attached SOW_draft_redline.pdf is standard? Laura — CS to confirm support milestones post-launch?

Attachments: StellarSys_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_redline.pdf

Best,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Updated MAP + proposed pricing (15% + $25k credits)

Marissa / team,

Reviewed the SOW redline. A couple quick notes:
- Indemnification language: we'll keep our standard clause but can review if their legal requests changes.
- DocuSign timeline: once pricing is approved, legal can turn the SOW in ~2 business days for internal review, then 1 business day to issue for signature.
- No unusual terms flagged in the redline; procurement should be comfortable with standard exceptions.

I'll prepare a short note for procurement to explain sign process and expected DocuSign timing.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Kate O'Connell <kate@stellarsys.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + proposed pricing (15% + $25k credits)

Marissa / team / Kate,

Thanks for the context. I'm OK approving the proposed concession: 15% discount + $25k onboarding credits for a 12-month reserved commit, conditional on:
- Procurement confirms the committed 12-month volume and billing cadence
- Legal confirms there are no non-standard indemnity or liability terms (Dev has flagged none so far)
- CS confirms support milestones and onboarding plan (Laura to confirm)

If procurement and CS confirm those points by EOD Tue 3/10, you have my signoff to present the concession to the customer. Marissa — please update the MAP to include the final commit language and circulate the DocuSign link once legal finalizes the SOW.

-Vivek
VP, Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
